reason: It just says 'halal-certified' and never says by who, so I can't be sure it's really halal. And £18 a month on collagen for myself is hard to justify when the family budget comes first.
objection: Who certified it? Without the name of a body I recognise, like HMC or HFA, 'halal-certified' is just a word on a website, and the 320 reviews on their own site don't prove anything.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the named halal certification body and the certificate, and someone in my family WhatsApp group saying they've used it and it worked.
